371:t_3:32.en:
$n
「Yeah. It's a shame I didn't get to try $$谷川$$'s special pork miso soup.」

371:t_3:33.en:
$$谷川$$
「Oh, $n. If that's how you felt, you should've told me sooner.」

371:t_3:35.en:
$$谷川$$
「'I want to eat your pork miso soup'... That's an unusual way to propose.」

371:t_3:37.en:
$$中原$$
「You really do like older women, $n.」

371:t_3:38.en:
$$入江$$
「But proposing out of the blue? That's daring... way too $$ダイターン$$-ing!」

371:t_3:40.en:
$$谷川$$
「But I'm sorry, $n. Until you settle things with Miss $$スズネ$$, I can't accept your feelings.」

371:t_3:41.en:
$$大山$$
「It's no use, $$谷川$$. $n is completely dazed and isn't listening.」

371:t_3:42.en:
$$トッポ$$
「Then shall we help ourselves to the ohagi?」

371:t_3:46.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I'm $$ティティ$$. ...Excuse me... Could I have some tea?」

371:t_3:48.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Ah... This is sweet and delicious.」

371:t_3:52.en:
$n
「$$ティティ$$...! Why are you here?」

371:t_3:55.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Yeah... It looked like fun, so... I tagged along.」

371:t_10:5.en:
$n
「...It's nothing serious. After a short rest, I'll get back to training.」

371:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Aren't you gradually making progress? You fought quite well even in $$ジェニオン$$.」

371:t_10:7.en:
$n
「It really drove home how much I'd been relying on Miss $$スズネ$$.」

371:t_10:8.en:
$n
「$$ジェニオン$$ was originally a single-seater. I have to be able to fight with it like this.」

371:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right, now that you mention it. I'd gotten so used to the two-seater setup that I'd completely forgotten.」

371:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But fighting the whole battle in $$ジェニオン$$ generated 50 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s for you, $n. I'll add them to the team's stock.」

371:t_10:11.en:
$n
「I feel like I'm close to grasping something... That hope probably produced the $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

371:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... Then shall I provide some despair too, to balance things out?」

371:t_10:13.en:
$n
「I'll pass. That stowaway is giving me enough of a headache already.」

371:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(At least that has taken $n's mind off his troubles a little.)

371:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(But the original $$ジェニオン$$, hmm...? What an intriguing thing for him to say.)

371:t_10:21.en:
$$勝平$$
「W-What, $$ＡＧ$$? That grin is creeping me out...」

371:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ワッ太$$ was complaining. He thought you were finally going to introduce him to your girlfriends...」

371:t_10:23.en:
$$勝平$$
「Who cares about that $$ブスペア$$!?」

371:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ブスペア$$...? What a cruel nickname for girls their age.」

371:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Or is it that common boyhood tendency? The more you like a girl, the more you want to tease her~?」

371:t_10:31.en:
$$勝平$$
「$$ＡＧ$$... I like you so much I can hardly stand it too.」

371:t_10:33.en:
$$勝平$$
「So I'm going to tease you good and hard! Get him, $$千代錦$$!」

371:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, stop! My body will rust if it pees on me!」

371:t_10:39.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「...At this rate, $$ＡＧ$$ won't be coming back here for a while.」

371:t_10:40.en:
$$恵子$$
「Then shall we mind the shop?」

371:t_10:43.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「It's not that. I'm just not very used to this sort of thing.」

371:t_10:44.en:
$$恵子$$
「That's true. With $$勝平$$ making so much noise on our team, we don't get much attention.」

371:t_10:45.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Since we have the chance, I'll let loose! Let's put our hearts into today...!」

371:t_10:48.en:
$$恵子$$
「Let's try shouting during the $$ザンボット・ムーン・アタック$$ next time too.」

372:t_000:2.en:
$$市民$$
「Are they after this refugee camp!?」

372:t_000:4.en:
$$梅江$$
「It's all right, everyone. $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ will come to save us right away.」

372:t_001:3.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「He has to protect the town where his mom and grandma are, after all.」

372:t_001:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「...Watch me, $$ワッ太$$. Picking up trash didn't settle our score, but I'll show you my power here!」

372:t_001:5.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「It's no use... He's fighting for completely personal reasons...」

372:t_001:6.en:
$$万丈$$
「The enemy vanguard is charging toward the town. We must not let them through.」
